connectors.name: I2C connector (left of USB)
connectors.orderNote: No pin 1 mark; started at the end closest to the USB-C connector (lower-right end of the diagonal connector)

connectors.name: UART connector (right of USB)
connectors.orderNote: No pin 1 mark; started at the end closest to the USB-C connector (lower-left end of the diagonal connector)

uncertain: Both connectors sit diagonally beside the USB-C port; the 'closest to USB' end was chosen by distance in the photo and is a judgment call for an angled connector.
notes: Only the I2C and UART JST connectors have per-pin labels; other connectors (RTC battery, speaker, battery) are unlabeled per pin and were skipped.
